definitions: An edible marine bivalve mollusc with a ribbed, fan-shaped shell.
A shell of a scallop, especially one used as a baking dish.
One of a series of curves or indentations along an edge, especially of cloth or food.
examples: We had fresh scallops for dinner.
The chef served the gratin in a scallop shell.
The dress had a delicate scallop trim.
